title: Actions related to transmission of LocationMeasurementIndication message

entities.name: LocationMeasurementIndication message
entities.description: RRC message used by UE to indicate start/stop of location related measurements and subframe/slot timing detection towards E-UTRA or NR.

entities.name: measurementIndication
entities.description: Information element in LocationMeasurementIndication message that indicates the type of measurement being started or stopped.

entities.name: eutra-RSTD
entities.description: Value set in measurementIndication when procedure is initiated for RSTD measurements towards E-UTRA.

entities.name: nr-PRS-Measurement
entities.description: Value set in measurementIndication when procedure is initiated for positioning measurement towards NR.

entities.name: release
entities.description: Value set in measurementIndication to indicate stop of location related measurements or stop of subframe and slot timing detection.

entities.name: eutra-FineTimingDetection
entities.description: Value set in measurementIndication when procedure is initiated to indicate start of subframe and slot timing detection towards E-UTRA.

entities.name: Location Measurement Indication procedure
entities.description: Procedure where UE transmits LocationMeasurementIndication message to indicate start or stop of location related measurements.

relations.description: LocationMeasurementIndication message contains the measurementIndication information element.
measurementIndication is set to eutra-RSTD when procedure is initiated for RSTD measurements towards E-UTRA.
measurementIndication is set to nr-PRS-Measurement when procedure is initiated for positioning measurement towards NR.
measurementIndication is set to release when procedure is initiated to indicate stop of location related measurements.
measurementIndication is set to eutra-FineTimingDetection when procedure is initiated to indicate start of subframe and slot timing detection towards E-UTRA.
Location Measurement Indication procedure includes transmission of LocationMeasurementIndication message.
